abort.already_configured: ESB Smart Meter is already configured. Only one instance is supported.

user.title: ESB Smart Meter
user.description: Configure ESB Networks CSV import settings. Set the tariff band times and rates to match YOUR supplier plan — the ESB export contains only usage, not pricing, so these cannot be detected automatically. The ESB portal username, password and MPRN are optional; fill them in only if you want Home Assistant to download the CSV for you.

init.title: ESB Smart Meter options
init.description: Update import and tariff settings. Changes apply after a short reload.

reload.name: Reload ESB smart meter data
reload.description: Re-scan the configured ESB CSV folder and update all ESB Smart Meter sensors.

download.name: Download from ESB Networks
download.description: Log in to the ESB Networks portal and download the latest interval CSV, then refresh sensors. Requires portal credentials and MPRN to be configured.

import_statistics.name: Import history into statistics
import_statistics.description: Backfill available CSV history into long-term statistics so past usage and cost appear on the Energy dashboard.

no_csv_data.title: No ESB smart meter data found
no_csv_data.description: No valid interval rows were found in `{path}`. Add ESB CSV exports to that folder (or configure portal download), then call the `esb_smart_meter.reload` service.
